mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% indicates labor market weakness that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE > 8.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) and weak employment growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.1%) signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and spending, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting both UNRATE > 8.0% and PAYEMS growth < 0.1%, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods with rising HOUST, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation that may trigger Federal Reserve rate hikes, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing output and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with rising INDPRO, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales growth (RSAFS > 0.5%) combined with stable monetary policy (FEDFUNDS change < 0.1%) signals robust consumer demand and accommodative policy, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with strong consumer demand
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances meeting both RSAFS growth > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS change < 0.1%, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 550.0 thousand units indicate a weakening housing market that dampens construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with HOUST < 550.0, or Rank IC < 0.03.
